mentions.name: Immigrant health insurance referral service
mentions.description: An insurance advisory service for immigrants in Germany. When the site's content and calculator are not enough, visitors are connected to a partner broker who provides a health insurance recommendation, with the broker vetted to prioritize honesty over revenue. Automation infrastructure is being built to streamline case tracking, document collection, and applications with insurance companies to handle growing demand.
mentions.problem: The author was not satisfied with the health insurance advice available to immigrants.
mentions.audience: Immigrants in Germany needing health insurance guidance and recommendations.
mentions.source_excerpt: I was not satisfied with the health insurance advice available to immigrants, so I paired up with a broker. When my content and my calculator are not enough, they can reach out to this guy and get a recommendation.
